lex:
ταπεινοφροσύνη, -ης, ἡ
(ταπεινόφρων)
lowliness of mind, humility: Act.20:19, Eph.4:2, Php.2:3, Col.3:12, 1Pe.5:5; of a false humility, Col.2:18, 23 (rare outside of NT, but found in bad sense in FlJ, BJ, iv, 9, 2; also in Epictet., see Tr., Syn., § xlii).†

strongs.kjv: humbleness of mind, humility (of mind, loneliness (of mind)
strongs.from: from a compound of G5011 (ταπεινός) and the base of G5424 (φρήν)
